## Definition of Done
- [ ] Runs against the full seeded dataset, not a toy fixture
- [ ] The deliberate failure was reproduced and observed (log / metric / trace / flame graph)
- [ ] An automated check exists that fails if it returns, and it runs in CI
- [ ] Non-obvious decisions have an ADR naming the rejected alternative
- [ ] Measurements are written down, not just conclusions
- [ ] Anything surprising is in a note
